roles.title: Upstream Manufacturing Team Leader & Process Software Engineer

achievements.text: Lead upstream manufacturing operations and drive strategic continuous improvement initiatives by architecting and deploying a GxP-compliant Manufacturing Execution System (MES), bridging plant stakeholder requirements with scalable digital solutions.

Analyze complex operational data and metrics using Python and PostgreSQL to detect systemic bottlenecks, successfully driving a 100% increase in product yield and a 9% reduction in operational losses.

Coach and manage plant personnel on new digital standard operating procedures, ensuring smooth cross-departmental workflows, zero downtime for critical tracking tools, and strict adherence to sanitary and quality regulations.

metrics.label: Downtime for critical tracking tools
metrics.evidence: zero downtime for critical tracking tools

achievements.text: Built and maintained an automated deviation control dashboard to streamline operational audits, standardize safety protocols, and track 50 concurrent variables across 12 simultaneous production batches.

metrics.label: Variables tracked across simultaneous batches
metrics.evidence: 50 concurrent variables across 12 simultaneous production batches

achievements.text: Contributed to the development and implementation of an electronic Manufacturing Execution System (MES) for process data recording, significantly improving inventory management and workflow traceability across the supply chain.

Programmed and deployed automated control systems for online filtration during aseptic filling, ensuring strict quality compliance, standardization, and seamless integration of software with physical plant operations.
Production of recombinant proteins expressed in prokaryotes and monoclonal antibodies produced in eukaryotes; operation of bioreactors and mechanical bioseparations.
achievements.originalText: Producción de proteínas recombinantes expresadas en procariontes y anticuerpos monoclonales producidos en eucariontes. Manejo de biorreactores y bioseparaciones mecánicas.

achievements.text: Contributed extensively to the development of a poultry vaccine against Avibacterium paragallinarum and its transfer to production.
achievements.originalText: Amplia contribución en el desarrollo de una vacuna para aves, que brinda protección contra la bacteria Avibacterium paragallinarum, así como su transferencia al área de producción.

achievements.text: Received the technology transfer for producing recombinant human G-CSF (Filgrastim) and Interferon α2A in E. coli (fermentation) and completed it with optimal results.
achievements.originalText: Recibir la transferencia de tecnología para la producción de G-CSF (Filgrastim) e Interferón α2A recombinantes humanos en Escherichia coli (Fermentación) y concluirla con resultados óptimos.

achievements.text: Implemented analytical methods for biopharmaceuticals, including cell-culture potency, residual DNA and host-cell protein assays.
achievements.originalText: Implementación de métodos analíticos para biofármacos, como prueba de potencia en cultivo celular, ADN residual y proteínas del hospedero.

achievements.text: Statistical analysis of biological assays and processes.
achievements.originalText: Análisis estadístico para ensayos y procesos biológicos.
